ref: ADR-0008 "Refused when a mapping uses the field": an abstract element type in a target is refused with abstract-target-element, reported at the authoringId of the target field mapping that uses the field, the message naming the abstract declaration's schema file, line and column; spec #89, ticket #95
note: derivation/order.xsd. T5 writes Remark/Text, and Remark is of the abstract complex type o:Remark, so compiling refuses the model with abstract-target-element at T5; its message names derivation/order.xsd and the end of o:Remark's start tag. The other target field mappings are those of structure/derivation/001 and stand. A source may read an element of an abstract type.
